I am 60 years old and I have been growing maize on this rented plot in Iringa for many seasons. The land is not mine, so I do not want to spend too much cash on it — if the owner takes it back, my money is gone with it. The rains here in the Southern Highlands are usually good, so I trust the season more than I trust my pocket. I will buy one small bit of urea for top-dressing if I can find the cash, use the maize seed I saved from last harvest, and do most of the work myself with help from my wife and one of my sons.
